item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently makes the statutory necessity finding concerning federal possession of the railroad system; the legally significant determination occurs in this segment, before the subsequent taking.","evidence":"I find that as a result of a labor disturbance there are interruptions, and threatened interruptions"},{"segment_id":"2","code":4,"rationale":"This segment inseparably combines the President’s present taking of possession and control, a self-executing legal consequence, with directions and discretionary implementation authority assigned to the Secretary.","evidence":"Possession, control, and operation of the transportation system owned or operated by the Chicago, Rock Island & Pacific Railroad Company (hereinafter referred to as the company) are hereby taken and assumed"},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The President directs federal agencies, the Secretary, and company management concerning cooperation and continued operation of the federally controlled system; these are implementation and internal-management arrangements rather than a new legal-rights disposition.","evidence":"All Federal agencies shall comply with the orders of the Secretary issued pursuant to this order"},{"segment_id":"4","code":4,"rationale":"This segment combines discretionary implementation authority for the Secretary, a present conclusive legal designation of federal possession, and a mandated later termination by the Secretary upon his determination.","evidence":"all properties taken under this order shall be conclusively deemed to be within the possession and control of the United States without further act or notice"}]}
